mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.voucher_id AS voucherId, o.status, o.create_time AS createTime, v.title AS voucherTitle, v.pay_value AS payValue, s.name AS shopName FROM tb_voucher_order o LEFT JOIN tb_voucher v ON v.id = o.voucher_id LEFT JOIN tb_shop s ON s.id = v.shop_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC

SELECT o.id, o.voucher_id AS voucherId, o.status, o.create_time AS createTime, v.title AS voucherTitle, v.pay_value AS payValue, s.name AS shopName FROM tb_voucher_order o LEFT JOIN tb_voucher v ON v.id = o.voucher_id LEFT JOIN tb_shop s ON s.id = v.shop_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.user_id = #{userId}
